subject: Manager playbook, timeline & data handling for review window

Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Manager playbook, timeline & data handling for review window

Team —

Attaching a near-final draft of the manager playbook and the timeline spreadsheet for the upcoming review window. This thread is to lock down: scope, manager deliverables, and the data-handling rules we’ll enforce for privileged roles. High-level asks:

- Please review the manager_playbook_v1.docx for tone and mandatory steps (pages called out in the doc).
- Confirm the timeline_spreadsheet.xlsx milestones and resource owners — I’ve proposed buffer weeks for calibration and appeals.
- Read the confidential-handling-guidelines.pdf and flag any legal/ops gaps (IRene, I’m relying on you here).

Key constraints: we need a two-week quiet window for sensitive roles, only managers + HR ops with explicit access should see unredacted packets, and we must finish manager training before packet distribution (target: June 7).

Deadline: please send inline comments or edits by EOD Wednesday (May 27). If you can’t make that, add a short note in the spreadsheet with your requested change.

I’ll collate and push an updated playbook on Thursday. After that we’ll schedule a 30-minute walkthrough for managers next week.

Attachments: manager_playbook_v1.docx (draft), timeline_spreadsheet.xlsx, confidential-handling-guidelines.pdf

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Head of People Operations (Interim)
Redwood Inference

Thanks Camila — I scanned the playbook and added inline suggestions (tracked changes). Two quick notes:

1) Manager checklist: can we add a mandatory confirmation checkbox for managers that they completed unconscious bias review (I left a comment on p.6)? This helps us in audits.
2) Timeline: the calibration week currently overlaps with an internal product launch kickoff on June 15 — Marcus, do you expect resourcing issues? If yes, we should shift calibration earlier by 3 days.

I’m fine with the quiet window proposal for sensitive roles; we should explicitly list the titles that qualify in the guidelines (to avoid ambiguity).

Irene — can you confirm the access control steps in the PDF? If legal needs to sign off, flag that here.

Thanks — quick update from my side.

- Product launch: yes, the June 15 kickoff has several cross-functional reviewers tied up June 14–18. I agree with Laura that we should avoid that week for heavy calibration meetings. Shifting calibration to June 9–11 (compressed schedule) is doable if managers get the packets by June 1.
- Manager training: I can host two 30-minute sessions on June 3 and June 4 (recorded). Recommend we require the live session for people managers of sensitive roles.
- Vendor support: I have a short call scheduled with Sophie Martin (peopleops vendor) on Thursday to confirm secure packet delivery workflow. Sophie will need the handling guidelines and the exact list of role titles we consider sensitive.

Proposed next steps:
1) Camila: finalize playbook with Laura’s comments by EOD Thursday and update the spreadsheet owners.
2) Irene: confirm access control steps and escalate any legal sign-off needs by Friday.
3) Marcus: confirm vendor call outcome and provide vendor checklist.

Marcus Lin
